Your holdings: SOXL (-44.23%) and SPAL (-30.62%) are in deep drawdowns and flagged "SELL." As leveraged ETFs, they decay and amplify losses, which is extra painful on margin. SMH is also down (-6.34%).

Watch: Keep a close eye on the market's underlying health, as the "alarming" weakness could hit your concentrated tech/chip book hard. Also, monitor the performance of your leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management and protect capital, especially with your leveraged positions, given the mixed market signals.
plays: Respect stops on SOXL and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are in deep drawdowns and flagged "SELL"; consider trimming to reduce margin exposure if they break key levels.
